title: Layer 3 Switching (SVIs)
description: Configure SVIs on a Layer 3 switch to route between VLANs.
scenario: Configure SVIs on a Layer 3 switch to route between VLANs.

concepts.title: Layer 3 Switch
concepts.body: A Layer 3 switch can route between VLANs using SVIs. Enable routing with "ip routing".
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# ip routing
SW1(config)# interface vlan 10
SW1(config-if)# ip address 192.168.10.1 255.255.255.0

concepts.title: SVI Routing
concepts.body: Each VLAN gets an SVI with an IP. The switch routes between VLANs at wire speed.

concepts.title: Verifying Routes
concepts.body: "show ip route" shows connected and static routes. Directly connected VLANs appear as C routes.
concepts.code:
SW1# show ip route
C  192.168.10.0/24 is directly connected, Vlan10
C  192.168.20.0/24 is directly connected, Vlan20
